methodological_issue_phash: The original perceptual_hash_duplicate_rate gate counted an image as duplicated when any earlier image was within pHash distance 2. This is order-dependent and, crucially, pHash-only: it flags perceptual-hash-near pairs that are not confirmed duplicates. Under the preregistered confirmed-duplicate rule (exact hash, or pHash<=2 AND SSIM>=0.98) the confirmed_duplicate_rate is 0 for all five official candidates; the flagged pairs remain a descriptive signal of structural similarity and possible reduced diversity, not confirmed duplication. Perceptual-hash any-neighbour and component-excess rates also depend on pool size and must be compared size-matched, not full-pool (1361 vs 340 vs 73).
methodological_issue_coverage: The original minimum_rad_dino_coverage=0.5 gate used a single balanced-point coverage from one 73-image synthetic subset. Coverage is unstable at this numerosity (200-repetition stability intervals are wide) and the 0.5 value was not derived from data. Real-vs-real coverage baselines (real train positives vs validation, and validation split-half) sit near 0.96-0.98 and provide an upper/reference benchmark, not a directly transferable synthetic eligibility threshold. Coverage is therefore retained as a descriptive/ranking metric rather than a binary hard gate.
